criteria.criterion: A rule is a line of .vloop/repo-guidelines.md starting `- ` at the left margin, in any section; a line inside an HTML comment (single- or multi-line) is not one. Provenance is a token D<8 digits>-<4 digits> or I<8 digits>-<4 digits>, optionally followed by the rest of the ID
criteria.evidence: internal/cli/doctor.go guidelineRules tracks comment spans across lines and uses HasPrefix(l, "- "); guidelineID regex matches [DI]\d{8}-\d{4}; doctor_test.go cases 'commented rule' and 'indented is not a rule' assert it

criteria.criterion: doctor prints a check `guidelines` right after `gate edits`, in text and as the next entry in --json: no file `- guidelines`; within budget with provenance everywhere `✓ guidelines <n> rule(s)`
criteria.evidence: doctor.go add(doctorGuidelines(root)) follows the gate edits add; doctorGuidelines returns resNA with no file and resPass '<n> rule(s)'; pinned in TestDoctorWorkedExampleText and TestWorkedExampleB5Session

criteria.criterion: Over 20 rules: `! guidelines <n> rules, over the budget of 20 — retire or merge some before adding more`; rules without provenance: `! guidelines <k> rule(s) cite no defect or intervention: line <a>, line <b>` with 1-based line numbers; both: one warning line, the two messages joined by `; `, the second keeping its `guidelines` (e.g. `! guidelines 21 rules, over the budget of 20 — …; guidelines 2 rule(s) cite no defect or intervention: line 5, line 6`)
criteria.evidence: doctor.go builds both messages, prefixes 'guidelines ' on the second only when the first exists, joins with '; '; TestDoctorGuidelinesRules cases 'seed plus 15', 'stripped', 'both' assert exact strings

criteria.criterion: The budget is 20 and not configurable; both are warnings: no exit code changes and doctor writes nothing
criteria.evidence: const guidelinesBudget = 20; results are resWarning (not resProblem); function only calls os.ReadFile; worked examples still exit 0 with warning count

criteria.criterion: TestDoctorWorkedExampleText (internal/cli/doctor_test.go), TestWorkedExampleB5Session, TestWorkedExampleB11 (cmd/vloop/b20261005_e2e_test.go) and TestWorkedExampleB13 (cmd/vloop/b13_e2e_test.go) change only by the new guidelines line and, where pinned, the warning count; committed tests cover the template (0 rules), the seed (6), seed plus 15 (21), stripped IDs, both, a commented rule and no file. criteria.evidence: diff touches only the doctor expected-output line in doctor_test.go and b5_e2e_test.go (adds '✓ guidelines 0 rule(s)'); B11/B13 do not pin the full output and are unchanged; TestDoctorGuidelinesRules covers template, seed, 21, 20, stripped, both, commented, no file; checks log go passed incl. cmd/vloop and internal/cli

criteria.criterion: No earlier test is weakened: only the tests the brief's Constraints list change, and only as they state
criteria.evidence: only two existing expectations edited, each by the added guidelines line; no assertions removed or loosened

notes: The 'seed' test case has 3 rules, not 6 as the brief says; the real seed file is not exercised, but the counting logic is covered. No test asserts the --json order directly; it follows from the add order.
